title: Saviors of Kamigawa: card flavor text

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane torn by the Kami War.

entities.name: The Kami War
entities.description: War between mortals and kami.

entities.name: General Takeno
entities.description: Human general defending Eiganjo.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: Ruler who never believed he would lose the war; his daughter Michiko left to find a way to restore him.

entities.name: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker
entities.description: Konda's daughter who left, vowing to return only when her father is brought back to his senses.

entities.name: Masako the Humorless
entities.description: Konda's servant.

entities.name: Noboru
entities.description: A master kitemaker.

entities.name: Snow-Fur
entities.description: A kitsune poet.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: A kitsune sage.

entities.name: Lady Azami
entities.description: Minamo wizard.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A character who compares himself to a masterless kami.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
entities.description: A goblin mirror breaker.

entities.name: Kiku, Night's Flower
entities.description: Assassin of Takenuma.

entities.name: Isao, Enlightened Bushi
entities.description: A bushi who speaks of Adamaro and Masumaro.

entities.name: Kenzo the Hardhearted
entities.description: Speaker who laments the loss of Kataki's blessing.

entities.name: Kensuke
entities.description: A houndmaster who employs akki after losing hounds.

entities.name: Dosan the Falling Leaf
entities.description: Monk whose chant is joined by a second deeper voice.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: Akki warlord who trains irregulars and brews a special drink.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Never relinquishes a grudge.

entities.name: Senka
entities.description: Orochi who leaves her colony to found a new one as broodmistress.

entities.name: Reki, the History of Kamigawa
entities.description: Man whose body tattoos were transcribed into The History of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kiyomaro
entities.description: Defender who did not let Eiganjo fall.

entities.name: Adamaro, First to Desire
entities.description: Spirit in whom all pain and anger is perfected.

entities.name: Masumaro, First to Live
entities.description: Ancestral spirit.

entities.name: Kataki, War's Wage
entities.description: Kami who once sharpened swords and hardened armor.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Castle city defended with mothriders.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: Town the kami plowed through.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: School abandoned during the war; overrun by ogres and oni.

entities.name: Takenuma
entities.description: Swamp filled with moans, shrieks and wails.

entities.name: Oboro, Palace in the Clouds
entities.description: Soratami palace of plots.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits at war with mortals.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Demons allied with ogres.

entities.name: Shiro
entities.description: A soldier who escaped the mist as his comrades fell.

entities.name: Mothriders
entities.description: Riders of Eiganjo's moths who joined the battle.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Goblin-like folk trained by Godo.

events.summary: Strain on the veil begins to show near the end of the Kami War.
events.quote: The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War.

events.summary: Takeno commands the archers at Eiganjo.
events.quote: Do not let a single shaft loose until my word.

events.summary: Mothriders join the fray in a great battle.
events.quote: The mothriders had joined the fray.

events.summary: Michiko Konda leaves home, promising to return only once her father is brought back to his senses.
events.quote: I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace.

events.summary: Masako recounts Konda's belief that he would not lose the Kami War.
events.quote: Konda never once believed he would lose the Kami War.

events.summary: Kami passing through the veil weaken it.
events.quote: The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became

events.summary: Ogres and oni sweep through Minamo while scrollkeepers hold their posts.
events.quote: not even when the ogres and their oni masters swept through Minamo.

events.summary: Minamo is abandoned and young students are thrust into the war.
events.quote: When Minamo was abandoned, its younger students found themselves thrust into a war beyond their skill with talents beyond their control.

events.summary: Takenuma fills with the moans of the living, dying and dead.
events.quote: Takenuma was filled with a chorus of moans, shrieks, and wails.

events.summary: Shiro is caught in a mist that kills his comrades.
events.quote: Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

events.summary: Kiku threatens a victim whose shadow will do the killing.
events.quote: I won't even lay a finger on you. I promise.

events.summary: Minor kami spill through a rip in the veil and vanish.
events.quote: Through the veil's rip spilled hundreds of minor kami

events.summary: Kami trapped for eons within the sacred gong destroy their prison.
events.quote: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

events.summary: Senka leaves her colony to found a new one as broodmistress.
events.quote: Senka left the colony of her birth and, with her attendants, set out to serve as broodmistress, founder of a new colony.

events.summary: Monks transcribe the tattoos of Reki's body after his death, producing The History of Kamigawa.
events.quote: After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body

events.summary: Even the benevolent kirin join the war against the mortal world.
events.quote: Even the most benevolent and life-giving of kami joined the war against the mortal world

relations.quote: each time I visit Lord Konda his guards are more on edge
Despite the massive forces that allied against him
Godo trained their muscles and honed their skills
